mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.5% signals economic weakness that triggers defensive sector rotation, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO decline > 1.0% from prior month) reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST rises by at least 0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.5%) prompts Federal Reserve tightening, increasing equity discount rates and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL annual change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS rise > 0.5%) and monetary easing (FEDFUNDS decline > 0.25%) signal strong labor market with accommodative policy, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market strength with monetary support
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS rises by at least 0.5% and FEDFUNDS falls by at least 0.25 percentage points from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%) drives robust corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 quarterly growth exceeds 2.0%.
